article.title: SoundHound與LG籌建美國電視商務渠道，先聚焦餐飲商戶
article.title_en: SoundHound and LG plan a US TV commerce channel, starting with restaurants
article.summary: 11月3日合作公告為商戶在LG智能電視接觸顧客鋪路，未列明正式上線日期。
article.summary_en: The November 3 partnership sets up merchant commerce on LG Smart TVs without specifying a launch date.
highlights: 合作範圍是美國，餐飲先行，零售等類別屬後續計劃。
公司稱可接入既有POS及廚房系統，參與餐廳毋須新增店內硬件。
highlights_en: The US initiative starts with restaurants, with other retail categories planned later.
The vendor describes existing POS/kitchen integrations without new in-store hardware.
article.why: 餐飲品牌評估新交易入口時，要先確認菜單、付款與既有訂單系統如何銜接。
article.why_en: Restaurant brands assessing a new channel should check how menus, payments and existing order systems connect.
article.next_step: 先向供應商查參與資格、上線時間與收費，再評估門店系統相容性。
article.next_step_en: Ask about eligibility, timing and fees before assessing store-system compatibility.
article.detail: 這份聲明公布的是合作與商戶招募方向，不能寫成所有美國LG電視已可下單。SoundHound介紹由其商戶網絡處理交易路由及結賬，並稱可串連餐廳現有系統。公告提及的既有餐飲客戶，也不代表已加入LG渠道。本報未引用裝置覆蓋數或推算銷售，亦未實測流程；品牌仍需核對參與商戶、商業條件及實際可用性。
article.detail_en: The announcement establishes a partnership and merchant-recruitment direction, not universal live ordering. SoundHound describes transaction routing and checkout through its network. Existing restaurant clients are not confirmed LG-channel participants. Launch timing, terms and availability need checking.
